title: Epoch View: compact telemetry tiles + token waterfall prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, glanceable ‘Epoch View’ for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance signals in a single row-oriented card set plus an expandable token waterfall. The view must work for dense ticket lists (quick triage) and for focused inspection (open waterfall + detail pane).

Summary of features: compact telemetry tiles (latency P50/P95, throughput RPS, token economics, error rate), a mini-sparkline for recent trend, a small inline quantile violin for latency distribution, and an expandable token waterfall microtrace that shows token grouping, model variant fallback indicators, and cost-per-token highlights. Rollout indicator and canary proportions should be shown as an overlay badge.

Design constraints: must be legible in a 320px-wide sidebar card, scale to full-width route overview, support keyboard navigation and screen readers, respect color-contrast for light/dark, and reuse Console design tokens. The waterfall must be static SVG-based for perf; animation limited to hover and expand to avoid rendering spikes in large lists.

Proposed layout (top-level):
- Row card: left-side model/route name + small pills for tags (region/variant).
- Middle: 4 compact tiles (Latency, Throughput, Tokens, Errors) each with a primary metric, micro-sparkline, and a delta indicator.
- Right: rollout badge + quick-actions (open waterfall, open route, open model page).
- Expanded: token waterfall panel with stacked bands (prefix, generation, tool calls) and per-band cost annotation.

Telemetry mapping: latency tile maps to p50/p95, violin on hover shows p10–p99; throughput tile uses small-area chart of RPS; tokens tile shows average tokens per request and cost-per-1k tokens using new pricing lanes; errors tile is a percent plus recent error trend.

Deliverables for handoff: figma prototype screens (compact, expanded, empty state), a11y checklist, chart spec sheet with data shape and suggested Vega-lite equivalents, interaction notes, and test script for a 5-user usability round.
acceptance_criteria: Compact row renders in Console list at 320px width without truncating primary labels
Tiles update correctly when time range changes; delta indicators show p50 delta vs baseline
Expand waterfall opens an overlay with token-level bands and cost annotations; bands align to token counts from telemetry query
Design tokens used for color and spacing; contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for primary text
Prototype linked in Figma and basic keyboard interactions documented (tab to expand, enter to open), and screen-reader labels provided for all interactive controls
Handoff includes chart spec: series names, aggregation window (1m/5m), percentile specs, and sample Vega-lite snippets
